summary: Aurora Cannabis Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a news release dated July 27, 2026, announcing that Institutional Shareholder Services (ISS) recommended shareholders vote FOR all resolutions at the upcoming Annual General Meeting, including director elections and say-on-pay. The filing is a routine proxy solicitation update preceding an AGM scheduled for August 7, 2026. It contains no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes. The registrant acts as a filer providing customary meeting-related information, with no deal terms or transaction mechanics to analyze.
